plugins.name: Miftah — مفتاح (Alpha)
plugins.description: Per-key model prices, markup/discount and optional exact-name LiteLLM reference import. Actual fallback billing with request price snapshots and stream usage fixes. Native /v1/models remains global; execution is per-key restricted. Safe state-lock handover since alpha.8; older versions need one restart. No Docker socket or custom image. STAGING ONLY: Linux amd64, glibc >= 2.34; NOT Alpine/musl or ARM64. Tested with CPA v7.2.146. Read INSTALL.md.
plugins.author: Abdulaziz
